SOURCE_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier of the source in the provider's
registry of sources.

SOURCE_KIND.description: What kind of data the source supplies.

ORIGINATOR.description:
Agency, operator or catalog that created the source data, as it names
itself. Not a message's CCSDS ORIGINATOR, which names who created the
message.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Identifier of the provider that published the product, as the provider
names itself: the module, node or service that retrieved the source data.

PRODUCER.description:
Identifier of the software that made the product from the source data,
with its version when it has one.

LICENSE_CLASS.description: What the source's terms permit for the product.

LICENSE_ID.description:
Identifier of the terms LICENSE_CLASS was read from: an SPDX license
identifier where one applies, else the identifier of the terms in the
provider's licence register.

LINEAGE.description:
Identifier of the lineage the source's data descends from. Sources that
republish one upstream share its lineage, so their products are not
independent of each other.

SIGMA_U.description: Position uncertainty along U, radial, in the UVW frame of this state (km, 1-sigma)

SIGMA_V.description: Position uncertainty along V, in-track, in the UVW frame of this state (km, 1-sigma)

SIGMA_W.description: Position uncertainty along W, cross-track, in the UVW frame of this state (km, 1-sigma)

MNV.description:
Spacecraft Maneuver

U, V and W are the UVW axes of an orbit state: U radial, along the position
vector away from the central body; W cross-track, along the orbit normal
(the direction of r x v); V in-track, W x U, completing the right-handed
frame. DELTA_VEL_U/V/W and DELTA_POS_U/V/W are in the UVW frame of the
pre-maneuver state at EVENT_START_TIME.

EVENT_ID.description:
Maneuver event identifier. Records of one event share it: a merged event
and the source records it combines.

MNVR_ACCELS.description:
Acceleration values (km/s^2): U, V and W per point, in the UVW frame of
the state at that point's MNVR_ACCEL_TIMES entry

SOURCED_DATA.description:
Sourced data references: identifiers of the records this one was
determined from (CIDv1 for records of this network), such as the source
records a merged event combines

PROVENANCE.description: Where the maneuver's data comes from and the terms it travels under.

MDEDetectOptions.description: Detection settings. Every field has its default.

DETECTORS.description: Detectors enabled; empty = Crossing and LevelShift, combined.

REPORT_TIME_MS.description:
Report time of the emitted maneuvers, Unix ms; 0 = the ephemeris
creation date.

PROPAGATOR_PORT_ID.description: Port of the propagator that answers window requests; empty = default.

K.description: D1 threshold multiple of the robust scale.

MEDIAN_SETS.description: Element sets in the running median.

SCALE_WINDOW_PAIRS.description: Pairs in the robust scale window.

GRID_STEP_S.description: Sampling step of the crossing search, s.

NEIGHBOUR_SETS.description: Neighbouring element sets each set is propagated across.

GLR_SETS.description: D2 element sets per GLR window.

LT_FLOOR_M_S_PER_DAY.description: D3 rate sigma floor, m/s per day.

MERGE_HOURS.description: Events of different detectors within this time merge, hours.

MDECrossingPair.description:
One pair of consecutive element sets, compared at the crossing of their
predictions.

SPAN_START_MS.description: Epoch of the earlier set, Unix ms.

SPAN_STOP_MS.description: Epoch of the later set, Unix ms.

CROSSING_MS.description: Time of closest approach of the two predictions, Unix ms.

CROSSING_AT_EDGE.description: True when the crossing is at an end of the span (no interior minimum).

IN_TRACK_M_S.description: In-track velocity change at the crossing, m/s.

STEP_IN_TRACK_M_S.description: D1 in-track step after the running median, m/s; NaN = not screened.

STEP_PLANE_M_S.description: D1 plane step, m/s; NaN = not screened.

THRESHOLD_IN_TRACK_M_S.description: D1 in-track threshold, m/s; NaN = not screened.

THRESHOLD_PLANE_M_S.description: D1 plane threshold, m/s; NaN = not screened.

CANDIDATE.description: True when D1 found a candidate here.

MDELevel.description: The level of one element set in the GLR series.

SET_EPOCH_MS.description: Epoch of the set, Unix ms.

LEVEL_M_S.description: Mean-motion level as an in-track speed, m/s.

PLANE_M_S.description: Orbit-plane vector scaled to speed, m/s (3 values).

MDEEvidence.description:
The statistic behind one event. A combined event lists the evidence of
each detector in COMPONENTS.

TIME_MS.description:
Time the component detector gave, Unix ms (for a combined event's
components); 0 = the event's.

PAIR_INDEX.description: D1: index of the crossing pair; -1 = none.

STEP_IN_TRACK_M_S.description: D1: step and threshold values, m/s; NaN = not computed.

CROSSING_AT_EDGE.description: D1: crossing at an end of the span.

SPAN_START_MS.description: Span (D1) or gap (D2, D3) start and stop, Unix ms; 0 = none.

GLR_STATISTIC.description: D2/D3: GLR statistic of the in-track (or rate) test; NaN = not computed.

STEP_M_S.description: D2: level step, m/s, and its standard deviation.

SIGMA_M_S.description: D2: sigma of the levels, m/s.

TREND_M_S_PER_DAY.description: D2: level trend removed, m/s per day.

OLD_LEVEL_SET_MS.description: D2: epochs of the last old-level and first new-level sets, Unix ms.

PLANE_GLR_STATISTIC.description: D2: GLR statistic of the plane test; NaN = not computed.

RATE_CHANGE_M_S_PER_DAY.description: D3: change of the level rate, m/s per day, and its standard deviation.

TREND_BEFORE_M_S_PER_DAY.description: D3: rate before the change, m/s per day.

COMPONENTS.description: C: the evidence of each component detector.

KEPT.description: C: the component whose time and size were kept.

IN_TRACK_M_S.description: In-track delta-v, m/s; 0 unless its test fired.

CROSS_TRACK_M_S.description: Cross-track delta-v, m/s; 0 unless its test fired.

RAW_IN_TRACK_M_S.description: In-track and cross-track estimates before the firing rule, m/s.

TIME_FROM_CROSSING.description: True when TIME_MS is a crossing time (else a gap middle).

BLOCK_BEFORE.description:
Indices of the history blocks (element sets or versions) before and
after the event.

ACCEL_CHANGE_M_S2.description: D3: change of along-track acceleration, m/s**2; NaN = not computed.

MNV_ID.description: ID of the $MNV record emitted for the event; empty when not emitted.

MDEDuplicateEpoch.description: An element set dropped as a republication of another.

MDERefusedSet.description: An element set that could not be used.

REASON.description: Reason, e.g. "a single element set" or the propagator's refusal text.

OBJECT_KEY.description: Object key: "NORAD:<n>", else OBJECT_ID, else OBJECT_NAME.

FRAME.description: Frame the history was screened in, e.g. "TEMEOFDATE", "EME2000".

DETAIL.description: Why the history was insufficient; empty otherwise.

DETECTOR_EVENTS.description: Every event each enabled detector raised, before combining.

OPTIONS.description: The options used, defaults filled in.

MDECompareOptions.description: Settings of a comparison of ephemeris versions.

REPORT_TIME_MS.description: Report time, Unix ms; 0 = from the versions.

WITHIN_VERSION.description: Also look for changes inside one version.

MARGIN_S.description: Margin around a planned ignition, s.

POST_START_AFTER_S.description: The post-burn version must start this long after ignition, s.

EXECUTED_FRACTION.description: Fraction of the planned change that marks EXECUTED.

CANCELLED_FRACTION.description: Fraction below which the plan is CANCELLED (<= EXECUTED_FRACTION).

UNPLANNED_THRESHOLD_KM.description: Semi-major axis change that flags an unplanned change, km; NaN = off.

MDEVersionChange.description: One comparison of two versions (or one version with itself).

OLDER.description:
Older and newer version descriptions; WITHIN names the version for a
WithinVersion change.

DETAIL.description: Why there was no comparison; empty otherwise.

IN_TRACK_M_S.description: In-track and cross-track equivalent delta-v, m/s.

MDEPlannedCheck.description: One planned maneuver checked against the versions.

GROUP_START_MS.description: Group of plans checked together, Unix ms.

DETAIL.description: Why it could not be decided; empty otherwise.

PRE.description: Pre-burn and post-burn version descriptions; empty = none.

MODELED_DELTA_SMA_KM.description: Semi-major axis change the plan models, km.

POST_MINUS_PRE_SMA_KM.description: Post-burn minus pre-burn semi-major axis, km.

EXECUTED_IN_TRACK_M_S.description: Executed in-track and cross-track delta-v, m/s.

MODELED_CROSS_TRACK_M_S.description: Cross-track delta-v the plan models, m/s.

MDEObjectSpan.description: A time span of one object.

MDEScoreOptions.description: Settings of scoring detections against known maneuvers.

BEFORE_S.description: A detection up to this long before a known maneuver matches, s.

AFTER_S.description: A detection up to this long after a known maneuver matches, s.

BINS_M_S.description: Delta-v bin edges for recall, increasing, m/s; empty = 0.05, 0.2, 1.0.

EXPLAINED.description: Spans where an unmatched detection is explained (not a false alarm).

ASSESSED.description: Spans where truth is complete (false alarms count only here).

SPANS.description: Spans of observation of each object (object-years).

RECALL.description: Recall, 0 to 1; NaN when TRUTH is 0.

WILSON95_LOW.description: Wilson 95 % interval; NaN when TRUTH is 0.

TIME_ERROR_ABS_S.description: Absolute time error of matches, s; absent when none.

DV_RATIO.description: Detected over known delta-v; absent when none.

IN_TRACK_RATIO.description: Detected over known in-track delta-v; absent when none.

MDETruthMatch.description: A known maneuver and the detection matched to it (if any).

ID.description: The known maneuver's ID and time, Unix ms.

DV_M_S.description: Known delta-v and its in-track part, m/s.

EVENT_ID.description: The matched detection's ID and time; empty and 0 for a miss.

TIME_ERROR_S.description: Detection minus truth time, s; NaN for a miss.

MDEUnmatchedEvent.description: A detection matched to no known maneuver.

ASSESSED.description: Inside an assessed span (a false alarm when not explained).

MISSED.description: Known maneuvers not detected (EVENT fields empty).

MDE.description: Maneuver Detection Evidence - exactly one arm is set.
